name: Microsoft Office
linux: LibreOffice (opens and saves Word, Excel and PowerPoint files), or Office on the web at office.com

name: Outlook
linux: Thunderbird, or Outlook on the web at outlook.com

name: OneDrive
linux: OneDrive on the web, or the free OneDriver app for a synced folder

name: iCloud
linux: iCloud on the web at icloud.com

name: Google Drive
linux: Google Drive on the web, or GNOME Online Accounts for a linked folder

name: Dropbox
linux: Dropbox has its own Linux app

name: PDF reader
linux: The built-in Document Viewer, or Okular; Firefox opens and fills in PDF forms

name: Adobe Photoshop or Lightroom
linux: GIMP or Krita for editing, darktable for raw photos, or Photopea in the browser. Adobe apps do not run on Linux.

name: Illustrator or CorelDRAW
linux: Inkscape

name: Video editing
linux: Kdenlive or Shotcut. DaVinci Resolve has a Linux version

name: iTunes
linux: Rhythmbox for music; Apple Music on the web at music.apple.com

name: Windows Media Player
linux: VLC

name: Paint.NET
linux: Pinta, which looks and works much the same

name: Notepad++
linux: The built-in Text Editor, or Notepadqq

name: WinRAR or WinZip
linux: The built-in archive manager opens zip, rar and 7z files

name: QuickBooks Desktop
linux: QuickBooks Online in the browser. The desktop version does not run on Linux

name: Quicken
linux: Quicken Simplifi in the browser, or GnuCash or KMyMoney. Desktop Quicken does not run on Linux

name: Tax software
linux: The browser versions (TurboTax Online and others)

name: Microsoft Teams
linux: Teams in the browser at teams.microsoft.com

name: Skype
linux: Skype has closed; Microsoft Teams in the browser replaces it

name: WhatsApp
linux: WhatsApp Web at web.whatsapp.com

name: Microsoft Edge
linux: Microsoft Edge has a Linux version; Firefox and Chrome also sync bookmarks

name: Antivirus
linux: Not needed on Linux. Keep updates on; ClamAV scans files if wanted

name: PC cleaner
linux: Not needed. MendKit's Free up space tool covers it

name: Printer software
linux: Most printers work without it. Brother and Epson publish Linux drivers; HP uses HPLIP (MendKit: Install HP printer drivers)

name: Device updater
linux: No Linux version. Keep a Windows or Mac computer, or use the phone app, for device updates

name: CAD software
linux: FreeCAD, or SketchUp and Onshape in the browser. Most Windows CAD apps do not run on Linux

name: Minecraft
linux: Minecraft Java Edition runs on Linux (Prism Launcher). Bedrock Edition does not

name: Games launchers
linux: Many games run through Steam's Proton or the Heroic and Lutris launchers. Games with anti-cheat (Valorant, Fortnite and others) do not

name: Kindle
linux: Kindle Cloud Reader in the browser, or Calibre for your own e-books

name: Visio or Project
linux: draw.io for diagrams, ProjectLibre for projects

name: Zoom
linux: Zoom has a Linux app
